description: Clean-install treatment of historical migrations that cannot be replayed verbatim on an empty database. Used only by scripts/clean-install/build-bootstrap.mjs. Historical migration files are never modified.

single_transaction.reason: The whole clean install runs as one transaction so that no scheduled job or queued request becomes visible until every migration, including 20261031090000, has run. Files that wrap themselves in BEGIN/COMMIT would otherwise commit early.

session_emulations.fresh_install_failure: UPDATE engineering_work_orders (EWO-030R.2 closed -> po_acceptance): "Governed lifecycle violation". The trigger enforce_ewo_lifecycle_transition skips validation when current_setting('app.bypass_lifecycle_validation', true) is NULL, which is the case in a fresh database session. The original project applied this file in its own session, so validation was skipped. In one long install session the setting is already defined (by 20260722023317 / 20260722024511), so validation runs and fails.
session_emulations.reason: Reproduce the original fresh-session behaviour for this one file by setting app.bypass_lifecycle_validation = true for that file only (transaction-local, reset before the next file). The file itself runs verbatim. It is the only NULL-sensitive session check in the history.
